full_track.tags: Cinematic orchestral folk. A solo flute carries the primary melody, characterized by wide intervals and expressive vibrato. A harp provides arpeggiated accompaniment in a constant eighth-note flow. Orchestral strings enter with sustained legato pads, building into a lush harmonic bed. The arrangement features a prominent glockenspiel doubling the flute melody for a bright, crystalline texture. A solo cello performs a counter-melody in the lower register. The piece is in 3/4 time at 85 BPM in the key of G Major. The production uses high-fidelity hall reverb to create a sense of physical space. The dynamic structure follows a gradual crescendo as more string sections are layered over the repeating flute motif.
